## Simulation

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
from autoemulate.compare import AutoEmulate
from autoemulate.simulations.epidemic import simulate_epidemic
from autoemulate.experimental_design import LatinHypercube
import numpy as np

beta, gamma = (0.1, 0.5), (0.01, 0.2)
lhd = LatinHypercube([beta, gamma])
X = lhd.sample(100)
y = np.array([simulate_epidemic(x) for x in X])
```

## Running AutoEmulate
```{python}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true
ae = AutoEmulate()
ae.setup(X, y)
ae.compare()
ae.plot_cv()
```

##

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false

from autoemulate.compare import AutoEmulate

ae = AutoEmulate()
ae.setup(X, y)                          # customise pipeline
ae.compare()                            # runs the pipeline
ae.plot_cv()                            # visualise results
ae.summarise_cv()                       # metrics for each model
emulator = ae.get_model("GaussianProcess")
ae.evaluate(emulator)                   # calculate test set scores
ae.plot_eval(emulator)                  # visualise test set predictions
emulator = ae.refit(emulator)           # refit using full data
emulator.predict(X)                     # emulate!
ae.sensitivity_analysis(emulator)       # global SA with Sobol indices
```

## 

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: false
# creating an emulator
ae = AutoEmulate()
ae.setup(X, y)                    # allows to customise pipeline 
emulator = ae.compare()           # compares emulators & returns best one
# cross-validation results
ae.summarise_cv()                 # cv metrics for each model
ae.plot_cv()                      # visualise best cv fold per model
# evaluating the emulator
ae.evaluate(emulator)             # test set scores
emulator = ae.refit(emulator)     # refit using full data
# application
emulator.predict(X)               # generate new samples
ae.sensitivity_analysis(emulator) # global SA with Sobol indices
```

## {.smaller}

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
import numpy as np
from autoemulate.compare import AutoEmulate
from autoemulate.experimental_design import LatinHypercube
from autoemulate.simulations.projectile import simulate_projectile

# sampling
lhd = LatinHypercube([(-5., 1.), (0., 1000.)])
X = lhd.sample(50)
y = np.array([simulate_projectile(x) for x in X])

# creating an emulator
ae = AutoEmulate()
ae.setup(X, y)                    # change pre-processing, parameter search etc.
emulator = ae.compare()           # compares emulators & returns best one
ae.evaluate(emulator)             # test set scores
emulator = ae.refit(emulator)     # refit using full data

# application
emulator.predict(X)               # prediction
#ae.sensitivity_analysis(emulator) # global SA with Sobol indices
```

## 
```{python}
#| echo: true
#| eval: true
ae.plot_cv(model="GaussianProcess", n_cols=5, figsize=(5,5))
```
